title: archkeel init — Draft the first contract

story.title: archkeel init — Draft the first contract

steps.title: Enter Init
steps.note: Init opens the project root and chooses the draft command. It does not start the Rust scanner.

steps.title: Request a draft
steps.note: Build a draft before writing any file.

steps.title: Draft a configuration
steps.note: Describe an individual scan or a system of multiple language parts.

steps.title: Find language areas
steps.note: Find the areas that the folder and manifest layout supports.

steps.title: Inspect folders and manifests
steps.note: Check the supported language layouts. A draft gives no fact about code and does not follow imports.

steps.title: Return the areas
steps.note: Return the discovered areas to the draft path. The runtime return is not observed.

steps.title: Return the draft
steps.note: Prepare the scan configuration, contract and provenance page. Leave responsibility and rationale decisions for their owners.

steps.title: Return to Init
steps.note: Once the draft returns, ask the writer to create its missing files.

steps.title: Create without replacing
steps.note: Create each file exclusively. An existing contract and its page stay in place.

steps.title: Report the files
steps.note: A successful run lists the new files and completes without a rule verdict. When every target exists, Init refuses to replace any.

steps.title: Finish without a verdict
steps.note: Exit 0 means the draft wrote files. Edit its TODOs and run Validate to get rule verdicts.
